title: Early Intervention for Postpartum PTSD: Comparing Written Exposure and Capnometry-Guided Breathing Therapy - Phase 1
official: Early Intervention for Postpartum PTSD: Comparing Written Exposure and Capnometry Guided Breathing Therapy - Phase 1
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the feasibility and acceptability of two early interventions, Written Exposure Therapy (WET) and Capnometry-Guided Breathing Intervention (CGRI), for reducing post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms following childbirth. This initial non-randomized pilot study aims to identify potential barriers and inform refinements to the interventions and study procedures for a subsequent randomized feasibility trial.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18
* Delivered a live infant within 5 days
* Severe maternal morbidity or infant admitted to NICU
* PCL-5 ≥28
* English-speaking
* Able to consent and participate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active psychosis or mania
* Current suicidal crisis
* Current suicidal intent or plan
* Cognitive impairment preventing participation
